protected_period.right_edge_rule: An event is evaluable only if its frozen 24h exit-open timestamp is strictly earlier than 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z. Any later event remains SOURCE_EVENT_RIGHT_EDGE_UNRESOLVED and is not used for economics.

source_population_contract.source_type: official Binance Support Launchpool announcement pages only
source_population_contract.inclusion: Official announcement published in calendar 2025 explicitly identifies a Binance Launchpool project and explicitly offers BNB staking or locking in a supported pool.
source_population_contract.exclusion: Launchpad, HODLer Airdrops, Megadrop, listing-only announcements, Simple Earn campaigns, or Launchpool announcements without explicit BNB staking/locking.
source_population_contract.publication_timestamp_rule: Use original Binance CMS publishDate / Published on timestamp, never later updated timestamp.
source_population_contract.completeness_rule: Search/reconcile all official Binance Support Launchpool announcements published in calendar 2025. Contiguous project numbering, when present, is used as a completeness diagnostic but not as the sole inclusion authority.
source_population_contract.duplicate_rule: Deduplicate by canonical Binance article code; distinct official articles remain distinct source events until the frozen clustering rule is applied.

execution_rule_unchanged.cluster_rule: Adjacent eligible announcements separated by <=60 minutes belong to one information cluster; cluster signal time is earliest canonical publication timestamp.
execution_rule_unchanged.entry: first 15-minute BNBBTC bar open whose timestamp is strictly greater than signal_time
execution_rule_unchanged.exit: BNBBTC 15-minute bar open exactly 24 hours after entry timestamp
execution_rule_unchanged.overlap_rule: If a later cluster entry timestamp is strictly earlier than active trade exit timestamp, suppress later signal; no stacking, replacement or delayed entry.

oos_statistics.profit_factor: sum positive base-net bps / absolute sum negative base-net bps; +inf if no negative trades
oos_statistics.concentration: maximum single-trade share of total positive BASE net contribution
oos_statistics.stress: reported as fragility; stress failure alone does not automatically fail Tier 2 under V2 if BASE remains positive and realistic
